title: Bitcoin eases to $77,900 as Binance customers pull $3.6 billion after withdrawals reopen
summary: Binance提現重啟後客戶撤資36億美元 Binance在重新開放提款後，客戶單日提領金額達到3.6億美元，同時BTC價格回落至77,900美元。

title: FBI Blames North Korea for $6B Binance Hack as Exchange Reopens Withdrawals
content: Binance saw $3.64 billion in net outflows in the first nine and a half hours after reopening withdrawals, or 2.1% of its assets, it said.
summary: FBI 指控北韓策動 60 億美元 Binance 駭客攻擊 在 Binance 重新開放提款後的前九個半小時內，淨流出達 36.4 億美元，佔其資產的 2.1%。 市場影響 巨額資金短時間內淨流出反映市場對交易所安全的擔憂，可能加劇短期流動性壓力與產業信心波動。

title: Morning Minute: Binance Hack Leads to Mass Outflows While FBI Opens Probe
content: Uptober was far from it, with the Binance hack punctuating a red month. Will November be better? Or will the Binance hack hang over crypto?
summary: Binance 遭駭導致大規模資金外流與 FBI 調查 Binance 發生駭客攻擊事件，引發市場大規模資金外流，並促使聯邦調查局（FBI）介入調查，為十月收官增添不確定性。
